$comment: OURS, transcribed from Cursor's OWN per-event stdout validators rather than from its prose, in the artifacts named in testdata/hostschemas/SOURCES.md (read 2026-09-10). This is the GATING reply, the one beforeShellExecution, preToolUse and subagentStart read; Cursor validates each event's reply with a different function, so the advise reply has its own file here, and that split is the same one cursor-guard.sh exists to work around. Open, and permission optional, because Cursor checks only the fields it knows and reads an absent permission as no opinion. What it does reject is a permission outside the enum, which is the whole bite of this file.
title: Cursor gating hook stdout

agent_message.$comment: Reaches the model. beforeShellExecution and preToolUse name it; subagentStart does not, and ignores it.
